title: Reaching states below the threshold energy in spin glasses via quantum annealing
summary: Although quantum annealing is usually considered as a method for locating the ground states of difficult spin-glass and optimization problems, its use in approximate optimization -- finding low- but not zero-energy states in a reasonably short amount of time -- is no less important. Here we investigate the behavior of quantum annealing at approximate optimization in the canonical mean-field spin-glass models, the spherical $p$-spin models, and find that it performs surprisingly well.
